candidates.change_summary: Remove the require check so that any caller (not just admin) can change winnersPerPeriod, ensuring the value can be set to something different than an admin would set.
Replace `isAdmin[msg.sender]` check with `msg.sender == _ownerAddress` so only the owner, not all admins, can update winnersPerPeriod, causing calls by other admins to be rejected.
Change the access modifier to a restrictive modifier that always reverts, making winnersPerPeriod impossible to update, so after a call the value remains unchanged rather than updated.
Set winnersPerPeriod to a constant value (e.g., 1) instead of the provided argument, so after the call it always becomes 1 regardless of input.
Delete the assignment so winnersPerPeriod is never changed, leaving any call to this function unable to alter its value.
Require that the new value is zero, so only zero can be set; any non-zero call reverts, and after a call with zero the value becomes zero, differing from expected.
